edges.relationship: CoinDesk reports the Binance14 EVM hot wallet was included in the Oct1 PoR set with 37 assets, including 89,475 ETH and 1.26B USDT.
CoinDesk estimates the 204,500 ETH theft could reduce ETH coverage from 100% to about 94% if not replenished.
Historical XRP transfers and explorer activation labels connect rDAE53 with rBtttd, rfQ9, rarG6 and rNU4.
233,461,943.1 XRP transferred across five validated XRPL payments during 20:05–20:09 UTC on Oct29.
Membership of the five XRPL addresses in the Oct1 PoR set remains unresolved because the official downloadable address file was not retrieved.
Range reports XRP as the earliest identified chain outflow at 20:05 UTC, before Solana, Bitcoin and the Binance14 EVM sweep.

hypotheses.claim: All five Binance-labelled XRPL source wallets were included in the October 1 Binance PoR address set.
support: historical internal wallet rotations connect the accounts
counter_evidence: Official downloadable PoR address file was not retrieved
CoinDesk's confirmed Binance14 finding is an Ethereum wallet, not an XRPL wallet
hypotheses.required_test: Obtain October 1 PoR address file and exact-match all five XRPL addresses.

hypotheses.claim: Some, but not all, of the five XRPL source wallets were included in the October 1 PoR address set.
support: They are exchange-attributed operational accounts with historical balances and transfers
hypotheses.required_test: Same authoritative address crosswalk; then reconstruct XRP balances at snapshot time.

hypotheses.claim: The 233.46M XRP drain caused a customer-backed XRP reserve shortfall at Binance.
support: Five exchange-attributed XRP source wallets were drained
counter_evidence: Other Binance XRP reserves may offset the outflow
Customer XRP liabilities at the relevant snapshot not yet reconciled
No post-incident XRP reserve snapshot available
hypotheses.required_test: Address-level PoR crosswalk plus October 1 XRP liabilities, reserve balances and November 1 replenishment snapshot.

hypotheses.claim: The XRP drain was part of a broader multi-chain compromise of Binance hot-wallet signing infrastructure.
support: XRP first outflow at 20:05, followed by Solana, Bitcoin and EVM
counter_evidence: Binance's full technical post-mortem is pending
Attribution and cross-chain actor linkage are analytics assessments
hypotheses.required_test: Binance incident post-mortem, signing-service audit summary and chain-by-chain transaction reconciliation.
